description: Properties that change at run time and are never drift (docs/drift-spec.md section 3.2 step 3). A changed property is set aside when a rule for its type covers it (the path or anything under it). A rule sets nothing aside until its exact digest is approved in the private drift-approvals.json.

rules.why: Start, stop and deallocate by autoscale, auto shutdown or Start VM on Connect.
Status, heartbeat, sessions, drain mode and agent versions the service updates on its own.
The registration token is renewed when hosts are added; it is a secret and never compared.
Last-modified stamps and ETags change with every write, including the platform's.
